## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and why it is incorrect.

## Minimal reproduction

Provide the command or a small synthetic trace/scenario that reproduces it. Include the seed when relevant. Remove credentials and real customer/payment records.

## Expected behavior and evidence

Explain the expected result and the observations supporting it. For verification problems, include the contract, source watermark, completeness, and origin fields when available.
